_comment: CAA identifiers by CA certificate, from CCADB's List of CAA Identifiers (https://www.ccadb.org/resources). Regenerate with tools/update_caa_data.py; do not edit by hand. by_ski maps a CA certificate's Subject Key Identifier (hex) to an index into 'sets', the domain names that CA recognizes in CAA issue and issuewild records (RFC 8659 §4.2); by_name is the fallback by the certificate's name, lowercased.
